context: Here we think of q(n) as a typical threshold function, for example: 1/n, c/n2 , log2 n/n, etc. The technical condition on q is required to rule out properties whose definition depends non-uniformly on n, eg. for small n, A is the property of containing a triangle, while for large n, it is the property of containing an edge. We conjecture that in fact all edge-monotone properties in Gd (n, r) can be characterized similarly: APPROX/RANDOM’14 504 On Sharp Thresholds in Random Geometric Graphs
